dial.summary: Six of eight macro indicators are now supportive after July ISM Manufacturing PMI surged to 55.6% (four-year high, upgraded from neutral to supportive), with BTC.D firm at 56.42%, TOTAL crypto rising to $2.23T, and near-zero funding rates confirming the BTC Accumulation thesis; only real yields (2.41%, above the 2% headwind threshold) and DXY (neutral at 99.97, hugging the 100 line) remain non-supportive ahead of July NFP (Aug 7) and CPI (Aug 12) as the next regime-change catalysts.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: MacroMicro 4-bank aggregate (Fed/ECB/BOJ/PBOC) confirmed at $102,663.81B (~$102.7T) for June 2026; July aggregate not yet published (central banks report M2 with ~30-day lag); US M2 weekly rose to $23.3T for the week of July 6, 2026 (vs $23.16T in June 2026, per H.6 released July 28), up +6.1% YoY—28th consecutive monthly increase and a record high; 4-week trend up (US M2 continued rising through July; global aggregate uptrend intact; YoY growth rate stable at ~5-6%); status supportive (4-week uptrend confirmed; YoY contracting headwind condition not met).

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: July 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI released August 3, 2026 at 55.6%—2.3pp above June's 53.3%, beat 54.0% estimate, highest since May 2022 and seventh consecutive expansion month; all five sub-indexes in expansion: Production surged +6.3pts (best in nearly five years), Employment broke into expansion for the first time in 33 months, New Orders accelerated; 4-week trend up: 53.3% (June) → 55.6% (July) = +2.3pp, well above the 0.5% relative flat threshold; status upgraded to supportive (above 50 AND rising; headwind threshold of 62 not met; a read above 55.6 corresponds to ~2.8% annualised real GDP growth per ISM).

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY at 99.97 on August 4, 2026—up +0.25% from Aug 3's 99.72 as the strong July ISM print (55.6% vs 54.0% est) provided modest USD support; 30-day trend: ~101.34 (July 1) → 99.97 (Aug 4) = -1.37%, well above the 0.5% flat threshold, trend remains down; status NEUTRAL per ICE DXY spot threshold (at 99.97, just below the 100 headwind boundary and above the 97.5 supportive boundary); a confirmed break above 100 would restore the headwind classification, while a break below 97.5 would upgrade to supportive; July NFP (Aug 7) and CPI (Aug 12) are the next directional catalysts.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: DFII10 (10-year TIPS real yield) at 2.41% as of July 29, 2026 (Macrotrends); Q2 GDP soft print (+1.5% vs 2.1% est) and core PCE miss (0.1% MoM vs 0.2% est) compressed yields to ~2.37% on July 31, but the ISM Manufacturing beat at 55.6% on Aug 3 likely pushed Aug 4 real yields back toward the July 29 level; 4-week trend up: ~2.18% (July 2) → ~2.41% (July 29) = +23bps, well above the 5bps flat threshold; status headwind (above the 2% absolute threshold AND rising on 4-week basis; September FOMC cut expectations moderated after ISM beat; Aug 12 CPI remains the primary real-yield compression catalyst).

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: July 31, 2026: DGS10 4.70%, DGS2 4.25%, spread = +0.45% (Forbes Advisor); 4-week comparison: July 2 spread ~+0.35% → July 31 +0.45% = steepening of +10bps, above the 5bps flat threshold, trend up; status supportive (positive AND steepening on 30-day basis confirmed; ISM beat at 55.6% may extend curve steepening as growth expectations lift the long end faster than the short end; headwind threshold of < -50bps not applicable at current +45bps spread).

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL from H.4.1 released July 30, 2026: $6,738,190M ($6.738T) for week ending July 29, 2026; prior week (July 22): ~$6.747T (Convex Trade); next H.4.1 release August 6, 2026; 4-week trend flat: ~$6.72T (early July) → $6.738T (July 29) = +$0.018T (+0.27%), within the <0.5% flat threshold; status supportive (flat to marginally growing; QT effectively paused since mid-2025; no aggressive runoff with rising overnight rates; balance sheet holding at post-2022 plateau).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: Live funding rate data inaccessible—CoinGlass and The Block returned HTTP 403; value carried forward at +0.004%/8h; contextual signals: BTC dominance rose to 56.42% (BTC market cap $1.26T, TOTAL crypto $2.23T as of Aug 4, 2026), consistent with accumulation phase rather than leveraged speculation; funding remains well below the 0.04%/8h overheating threshold; 30-day trend down (from ~+0.006%/8h in late June); status supportive (near-zero positive rate signals healthy long bias without overheating; macro improving with ISM at 55.6% supports continued spot accumulation over leveraged longs).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$301B (USDT $186.4B, USDC $74.9B, combined 86.7%) as of August 4, 2026; total crypto market cap $2.23T (BTC $1.26T, BTC.D 56.42%); stablecoin dominance $301B / $2.23T ≈ 13.5%; 30-day trend down: June 30 ~$305B / $2.10T = ~14.5% → Aug 4 ~13.5%, compression of ~1.0pp as capital rotated from stablecoins into risk assets; status supportive (falling on 30-day basis; headwind threshold requires rising dominance WHILE TOTAL crypto is also rising—not met since dominance fell while TOTAL rose on 30-day basis).

upcoming.title: ISM Services PMI (July 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM Services PMI for July 2026 at 10:00 AM ET—companion to the August 3 Manufacturing beat (55.6%, 4-year high); prior June 2026 reading: 54.0% (24th consecutive expansion month); consensus estimate clusters around 53–55; a reading above 54 with price moderation would compound the ISM Manufacturing beat and further test September FOMC cut pricing while reinforcing the BTC Accumulation macro environment; a miss below 52 alongside a weak August 7 NFP would revive September cut expectations and potentially compress real yields from 2.41%.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended August 1, 2026)
upcoming.note: Weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET—labor market pulse one day ahead of July NFP (August 7); prior week ended July 26: 226k; also the date of the Fed's H.4.1 balance sheet release (week ending July 30 data); a print above 250k would add September rate cut pricing and could compress real yields from 2.41%; a sub-220k print would reinforce the strong ISM Manufacturing signal (55.6%) and add upward pressure to yields and DXY, which is already testing the 100 headwind threshold at 99.97.

upcoming.title: Employment Situation / NFP (July 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS Employment Situation for July 2026 at 8:30 AM ET—nonfarm payrolls, unemployment rate, and average hourly earnings; primary labor market read ahead of the September FOMC (Sep 15–16); macro backdrop: DXY at 99.97 (neutral, -1.37% over 4 weeks), 2s10s at +0.45% (supportive), real yields at 2.41% (headwind), ISM Manufacturing upgraded to supportive at 55.6%; a weak NFP (<100k) would push September cut odds above 80% and could compress real yields toward 2% and DXY below 97.5 (flipping to supportive); a strong NFP (>200k) reinforces the ISM Manufacturing signal and may keep DXY above 100 (restoring headwind status); consensus estimates cluster around 150–175k.
